_why: DECLARED DEPENDENCIES. This child may import its own files plus these, and NOTHING else. gitEr/hitch_test.sh enforces it in a sterile room where ReTreever does not exist. Adding a line here is a DECISION, not a formality: anything starting with $lib, $tinyStore or $mobRoutes, or climbing into ReTreever, is a NO.
_channel_why: THE CHANNEL. One door to the host. The child names the channel, never ReTreever. A host wires its real implementation in; rapper wires a fixture. Anything the channel does not provide comes back null and the child renders nothing rather than crashing. Every $-import outside this prefix is a SECOND DOOR and hitch_test.sh reports it. CHANGED IN RAPPER PHASE 1: this used to name $parent/siblings/mapShared/ — a folder SHARED by every child. mapShared is gone; its modules went DOWN into the children that actually used them, so the channel is now a path INSIDE this child and travels with it when the child is lifted.
_shared_tree_why: THE SHARED TREE. `$rig/…` (the mounting tier's layout and dev chrome), `$gc/…` (Get Cache theme and art) and `$rt/…` (brand assets) are three aliases every mounting tier defines, all pointing at ONE copy of the tree that lives in the tier that owns it — nothing is copied or synced, and this child never says where. Dev chrome renders only under vite dev; the assets are what a page shows. Declared here so hitch_test.sh can tell a reviewed seam from a second door. A child cloned alone defines none of the three and fails LOUDLY at build, which is the point.
